title: Immich PostgreSQL
description: Dedicated PostgreSQL with pgvecto-rs and pgvectors for Immich photo management
note: Deploys 1 container: immich-postgres. Uses the Immich-specific PostgreSQL image with pgvecto-rs and pgvectors extensions. Port defaults to 5433 to avoid conflict with the shared PostgreSQL instance. Bound to 127.0.0.1 by default.
